sections.title: Java Coding Foundations
sections.goal: 🎯 Start here if writing code from scratch is difficult.💡 Goal: Get comfortable with syntax, input/output, loops, and methods.

exercises.name: 🖨️ Print output
exercises.description: Print your name, age, and a calculated result

exercises.name: ⌨️ Read input
exercises.description: Read integer + word using Scanner; print both

sections.title: Arrays
sections.goal: 🎯 Learn indexes, traversal, updates, and edge cases.💡 Rule: Always check nums.length == 0 and null before coding.

exercises.name: 🔄 Rotate by K
exercises.description: Right by k steps; handle k > n

sections.title: Strings
sections.goal: 🎯 Practice charAt, length, loops, comparisons, StringBuilder.💡 Rule: == compares references; .equals() compares values.

sections.title: Hashing & Sets
sections.goal: 🎯 Learn when maps and sets make problems simpler.💡 Rule: HashMap for counts/lookups; HashSet for existence/duplicates.

sections.title: Two Pointers & Sliding Window
sections.goal: 🎯 Use moving indexes for arrays and strings.💡 Rule: Two pointers usually need sorted input; sliding window usually needs contiguous subarrays.

sections.title: Searching, Sorting & Prefix Sums
sections.goal: 🎯 Implement mechanics before harder variations.💡 Rule: Binary search needs sorted input and a monotonic condition.

sections.title: Linked Lists
sections.goal: 🎯 Draw nodes and pointers before coding.💡 Rule: Always handle head == null and single-node lists.

sections.title: Stacks & Queues
sections.goal: 🎯 Understand LIFO and FIFO by implementing operations.💡 Rule: Stack = push/pop; Queue = enqueue/dequeue.

sections.title: Recursion & Backtracking
sections.goal: 🎯 Every recursive solution needs a base case.💡 Rule: Define base case → recurse → combine results.

sections.title: Trees, Heaps & Graphs
sections.goal: 🎯 Learn traversals and representation before advanced algorithms.💡 Rule: Trees = recursion; Graphs = BFS/DFS + visited set.

sections.title: Dynamic Programming
sections.goal: 🎯 Move from recursion → memoization → tabulation.💡 Rule: Define state → transition → base case → answer.

sections.title: Greedy Algorithms
sections.goal: 🎯 Make the locally optimal choice at each step.💡 Rule: Greedy works only when local optimum leads to global optimum.

sections.title: Bit Manipulation
sections.goal: 🎯 Use bitwise operations for compact, fast solutions.💡 Rule: x & (x - 1) clears the lowest set bit.

sections.title: Advanced Data Structures
sections.goal: 🎯 Build specialized structures for interview edge cases.💡 Rule: Know when to use Trie vs Union-Find vs Segment Tree.

sections.title: Math & Number Theory
sections.goal: 🎯 Handle edge cases in numeric problems.💡 Rule: Watch for overflow; use long when in doubt.

sections.title: Matrix Problems
sections.goal: 🎯 Master 2D grid traversal and in-place updates.💡 Rule: Define directions array {{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}}.

sections.title: Design Problems
sections.goal: 🎯 Combine data structures to meet operation constraints.💡 Rule: State the time complexity of each operation.

sections.title: System Design for DSA
sections.goal: 🎯 Connect DSA patterns to real backend systems.💡 Rule: Always state assumptions, constraints, and trade-offs.
